name: Jellycast
description: Discovers Google Cast (Chromecast) devices on the local network and exposes each one as a session in Jellyfin's existing cast/remote-control interface. Once installed, Chromecast devices show up automatically in the cast button already present in jellyfin-web, and playback is controlled the same way as casting to any other Jellyfin client session.
overview: Cast to Google Cast devices from Jellyfin's built-in cast interface
